status: Winter G approved for implementation on 2026-10-04; previous Winter studies rejected
scope: 15 studies; Winter G preserves the original silver model and the two separate stones. Eyelense red doorway direction accepted.

concepts.title: Winter A — twin court
concepts.description: Closest to the brief: paired silver portals, central caged topaz, low white wall wings and a winter forecourt.
concepts.review: Strong jewelry identity and two clear passages; background is denser and more urban than the intended west meadow.

concepts.title: Winter B — splayed ribbons
concepts.description: Lighter crossed silver ribbons, outward trumpet terminals and a small winter garden within the summer meadow.
concepts.review: Strongest figure-eight silhouette and a clear localized winter/summer boundary. Check actual ribbon splay and path rejoining in a later plan view.

concepts.title: Winter C — winter courtyard
concepts.description: White masonry crescents with silver inner bands, a flatter topaz crown, seating and a side ice pool.
concepts.review: Strongest masonry/garden integration. Stone mass is heavier and silver less dominant than the brief; compare that tradeoff before choosing.

concepts.title: Eyelense A — black crescent
concepts.description: Closest to the pendant: black crescent, threaded brass loops, high tinted lens and a suspended glass ring with red bead.
concepts.review: Faithful color and motifs, with open lower passage. Right foot becomes a slender brass support and background is too urban for the planned site.

concepts.title: Eyelense B — folded canopy
concepts.description: A deeper black curl with the tinted lens acting as a partial overhead canopy; a more sheltered threshold.
concepts.review: Lens reads as an overhead canopy and the meadow is clearer. Still close to A; right support is again brass, and the lens tint is fairly dark.

concepts.title: Eyelense C — leaning wave
concepts.description: A flowing black arch with both feet in black, an overhead lens and a longer bench integrated with the heavier base.
concepts.review: Both structural feet read in black and seating belongs to the landmark. Most coherent complete Eyelense gate in this pass; camera remains more frontal than requested.

concepts.title: Winter D — horizontal eye
concepts.description: A large horizontal blue eye wrapped in silver honeycomb; the central opening becomes the walking route.
concepts.review: Clearly horizontal silhouette and wide open centre. This explores one passage through the blue eye, replacing the earlier two adjacent ring passages.

concepts.title: Winter E — crystal passage
concepts.description: A deeper horizontal topaz surround and short crystal-lined passage, integrated with white masonry wings.
concepts.review: The horizontal outer silhouette is strong, with a narrower rounded inner aperture and visible crystal thickness. A more substantial alternative to D.

concepts.title: Eyelense D — red ring doorway
concepts.description: The enlarged red bead becomes a faceted red ring doorway inside the black crescent, with its clear outer glass rim.
concepts.review: The broad red ring makes the doorway unmistakable. Clear outer glass ring and brass crest suspension retain the pendant’s layered motif.

concepts.title: Eyelense E — passage through the bead
concepts.description: A thicker rounded red jewel with an arched passage through it, preserving more of the original bead’s volume.
concepts.review: Most literal passage through the enlarged red bead: more red body around a narrower arched opening. Confirm desired width and depth in later architectural views.

concepts.title: Winter F — closed shutter
concepts.review: Rejected: missed the smaller stone behind the clear outer stone

concepts.title: Winter F — open shutter
concepts.review: Rejected: missed the smaller stone behind the clear outer stone

concepts.title: Winter F — interior
concepts.review: Rejected: follows the incorrect single-stone exterior
